# KiJi

KiJi is a local-only desktop RSS reader. Stations, Defuddle/Readability parsers, Markdown sync for saved articles.

Brand summary:

- Local-only — feeds and state stay on disk.
- Stations — tag feeds into groups; flip unread ↔ saved — no timeline.
- Reader mode — Defuddle + Readability — two engines to parse raw page HTML into article text.
- Markdown sync — sync articles to local folder as markdown.
